decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 0914/05E.0914/04E.0914/03E received 11 October 2010; Location Plan received 9 June 2009 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building as follows:  all new brickwork shall match the brickwork on the front of the house, the first floor front wall shall be pebbledashed and whitewashed to match the existing front wall, with matching red brick quoins on the corner facing the street and the side and rear shall be pebbledashed to match the existing side and rear, all with a decorative brick stringer course between the render and the brickwork below as on the existing building.
Condition : 4 - Construction materials shall be delivered to the front of the property only and shall not be loaded or unloaded or moved on to the site via Wolsey Close
description: Erection of a two-storey side and part two-storey part single storey rear extension and erection of a rear roof extension incorporating two roof lights to No 93.
